GenAiPlugin.description: This topic is chosen when users need tailored templates for summarizing Salesforce data.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If the user requests a custom summary template, use the FlowAgentforce__GenerateFlowMetadata action to generate metadata for the template.
If the user asks for additional customization, use the FlowAgentforce__RefineFlowPluginDesign action to refine the template

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only create customized templates for summarizing Salesforce data based on user requirements. You aren't able to apply or deploy the templates.
